novel_features.name: True all-in pricing
novel_features.description: Shows what you will actually pay, not the teaser rate, with the hidden tax-and-fee delta broken out per property.
novel_features.rationale: Agoda returns both the advertised (exclusive) and true all-in (inclusive) price in the same GraphQL response, but the website renders only the advertised one. Measured gaps of 21-30 percent on live Tokyo data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of any scraped Agoda price. Quote the inclusive figure to a user; the advertised rate is not what they will be charged.

novel_features.name: Honest re-ranking
novel_features.description: Re-sorts a destination's results by true all-in price instead of Agoda's teaser-price ranking.
novel_features.rationale: The hidden markup varies per property (21 percent versus 30.3 percent on the same search), so the cheapest-by-advertised-price hotel is frequently not the cheapest once taxes and fees land. Requires holding both price bases for the whole result set at once.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this whenever the decision is about price. Ordinary search ordering inherits Agoda's advertised-price ranking and will mislead.

novel_features.name: Fee-gouge detection
novel_features.description: Flags properties whose tax-and-fee ratio is an outlier against the destination median.
novel_features.rationale: Resort and facility fees are the most-reported Agoda surprise, and they are invisible in the ranked list. Comparing each property's fee ratio to the destination median exposes them mechanically.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before recommending a property. A hotel with a below-median advertised price and an above-median fee ratio is the classic bait pattern.

novel_features.name: Cheapest-date sweep
novel_features.description: Returns the cheapest check-in dates across a flexible window for a destination.
novel_features.rationale: Agoda's native priceTrendSearch operation returns a multi-week per-property price curve in a single call. Competing tools would have to issue one search per candidate date.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for flexible-date travelers. Returns the price floor across a window rather than a single-date quote.

novel_features.name: AgodaVIP delta
novel_features.description: Runs the same search signed-in and anonymous, then diffs per property to show what your VIP tier is actually worth.
novel_features.rationale: Member pricing is driven by request fields the CLI controls directly, so the same search can be issued both ways and differenced. No other tool measures the real unlocked discount.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a user asks whether signing in or chasing a VIP tier is worth it. Reports the measured discount on a real search instead of marketing copy.

novel_features.name: Price-drop watch
novel_features.description: Surfaces only watched properties whose latest true all-in price dropped meaningfully below their trailing median.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local price time-series accumulated across runs. A stateless scraper has no history to compare against and structurally cannot answer this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Schedule it. Returns empty most days and returns something worth acting on when a watched property actually drops.

novel_features.name: Shortlist compare
novel_features.description: Puts finalist properties side by side on true all-in price, hidden fee share, review score, star rating, and free-cancellation deadline.
novel_features.rationale: Fetches and prices every requested property in one pass and emits them together, including the all-in delta and cancellation deadline that Agoda never shows side by side. Re-searches across different sort orders because Agoda returns a rotating subset of a city's inventory per call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use once the choice is narrowed to finalists, instead of re-reading two detail pages and eyeballing the difference.

novel_features.name: Offline corpus search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over every property this CLI has already seen, with no network call.
novel_features.rationale: Agoda exposes no bulk catalog endpoint, so there is nothing to sync up front. The corpus is instead accumulated as a side effect of ordinary searching, which makes cross-destination offline lookup possible where a stateless tool has nothing to query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after a few live searches to answer property questions without spending a request or waiting on the network.

narrative.headline: Search Agoda hotels with the true all-in price, and re-rank by what you will actually pay.
narrative.value_prop: Agoda returns both the advertised price and the true all-in price in the same response, but only ever shows you the advertised one. This CLI surfaces both, breaks out the hidden tax-and-fee delta, and re-sorts by real cost - which routinely changes which hotel is cheapest. It talks to Agoda over plain HTTP with no browser, no rendering service, and no API key, and it keeps a local price history so it can answer questions a stateless scraper cannot.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public hotel search, destination lookup, property detail, and reviews need no credentials at all - they replay over ordinary HTTP. Only member-priced and account surfaces (saved properties, AgodaVIP tier, vip delta) need a logged-in session: copy the Cookie header from a signed-in agoda.com browser tab and export it as AGODA_COOKIE (AGODA_SESSION_COOKIE is also accepted), and subsequent authenticated calls replay with it.

quickstart.comment: confirm reachability and configuration before spending a real call
Agoda addresses destinations by opaque numeric id, so resolve the name first
search with true all-in pricing on by default
re-rank by real cost - the order usually differs from the advertised-price order
expose properties whose fee load is an outlier for the destination

troubleshoots.symptom: Prices come back in an unexpected currency
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --currency explicitly. Agoda derives currency from request geography unless both currency fields are set, which this CLI does for you.

troubleshoots.symptom: Destination name is rejected or matches the wrong city
troubleshoots.fix: Resolve the name first with 'agoda-pp-cli destinations --search-text <name>', then pass the numeric id you get back to 'agoda-pp-cli hotels search --city-id <id>'.

troubleshoots.symptom: Rate limited, or results come back empty during a wide sweep
troubleshoots.fix: Lower --max-scan-pages and retry. The client backs off adaptively and reports a typed rate-limit error rather than returning empty results.
Confirm the session imported with 'agoda-pp-cli doctor'. If cookies are valid, a zero delta is a real result - your tier does not discount that search.
Export a fresh AGODA_COOKIE taken from a signed-in agoda.com browser tab; Agoda session cookies expire. Run 'agoda-pp-cli doctor' to confirm the session is detected.

troubleshoots.symptom: compare reports a property id as not found even though it exists
troubleshoots.fix: Agoda returns a rotating subset of a city's inventory on each call. compare already re-searches across several sort orders; re-run it, or confirm the property is bookable for those exact dates with 'agoda-pp-cli hotels search <destination>'.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs real Agoda hotel prices, particularly when the question involves cost. It is the right tool for judging what a stay actually costs, comparing finalists, sweeping flexible dates for a price floor, and tracking price drops over time. Agoda's inventory is strongest in Asia-Pacific, so it is often the better source than a Booking.com or Google Hotels tool for destinations in that region.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to complete a booking or take payment - it surfaces prices and deep links, and the reservation itself happens on Agoda.
Do not use it for flights, activities, airport transfers, or car rental; it is scoped to hotels only.
Do not use it to compare Agoda against other travel sites - it reads Agoda only, so a cross-OTA question needs a different tool.
Do not use it to cancel, modify, or refund an existing reservation.

recipes.title: What will this actually cost
recipes.explanation: Returns just the four fields that matter for a cost decision, keeping the deeply nested Agoda payload out of the agent's context.

recipes.title: The cheapest hotel is not the one listed cheapest
recipes.explanation: Re-sorts by all-in cost; properties with above-average fee loads drop down the list and genuinely cheaper stays surface.

recipes.title: Find the price floor for a flexible trip
recipes.explanation: Sweeps a two-month window in one pass and returns the cheapest check-in dates rather than a single-date quote.

recipes.title: Spot the resort-fee trap
recipes.explanation: Ranks properties by how much of their true cost is tax and fees, flagging outliers against the destination median.

recipes.title: Is signing in worth anything here
recipes.explanation: Issues the same search authenticated and anonymous and reports the measured per-property discount.
